sn16.6:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kassapaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.6:1.5: ahaṃ vā Kassapa bhikkhū ovadeyyaṃ tvaṃ vā
sn16.6:1.6: ahaṃ vā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammikathaṃ kareyyaṃ tvaṃ vāti || || 4
sn16.6:2.1: Dubbacā kho bhante etarahi bhikkhū dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā akkhamā apadakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ ||
sn16.6:2.2: Idhāhaṃ bhante addasaṃ Bhaṇḍaṃ ca nāma bhikkhuṃ Ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ Abhiñjikaṃ ca nāma bhikkhuṃ Anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadante ||
sn16.6:2.3: Ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati || ko sundarataram bhāsissati || ko cirataram bhāsissatīti || || 5
sn16.6:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn16.6:3.2: Ehi tvam bhikkhu || mama vacanena Bhaṇḍaṃ ca bhikkhum Ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ Abhijikaṃ ca bhikkhum Anuruddhassa saddhivihārim āmantehi
sn16.6:3.4: Evam bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato patissutvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca ||
sn16.6:4.1: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhum paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.6:4.2: Saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadatha ||
sn16.6:4.3: Ehi bhikkhu || ko bahutaram bhāsissati ko sundarataram bhāsissati ko cirataram bhāsissatīti || ||
sn16.6:4.5: Kiṃ nu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha || ||
sn16.6:4.6: Etha tumhe bhikkhave aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadatha ||
sn16.6:4.7: Ehi bhikkhu || ko bahutaram bhāsissati ko sundarataram bhāsissati ko cirataram bhāsissatīti || ||
sn16.6:4.9: No ce kira me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitam ājānātha || atha kiñcarahi tumhe moghapurisā kiṃ jānantā kiṃ passantā evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadatha || ||
sn16.6:4.10: Ehi bhikkhu || ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataram bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti || || 11
sn16.6:5.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn16.6:5.2: Accayo no bhante accayamā yathā bāle yathā mūḷhe yathā akusale || ye mayam evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadimha ||
sn16.6:5.3: Ehi bhikkhu || ko bahutaram bhāsissati ko sundarataram bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti || ||
sn16.6:5.4: Tesanno bhante Bhagavā accayam accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā ti || || 12
sn16.6:6.1: Taggha tumhe bhikkhave accayo accayamā yathā bāle yathā mūḷhe yathā akusale || ye tumhe evaṃ svākhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃsu tena accāvadittha ||
sn16.6:6.2: Ehi bhikkhu || ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataram bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti || ||
sn16.6:6.3: Yato ca kho tumhe bhikkhave accayam accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarotha || taṃ vo mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma || || 13
sn16.6:6.4: Vuddhi hesā bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ ca saṃvaram āpajjatīti || ||
